bagPolicy.summary: Fans attending events at Rosemont Theatre cannot bring backpacks, totes, mid/large sized bags, and coolers. Diaper bags with a child and medically necessary bags are allowed after a security search.
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags with a child and bags approved for medical needs are exceptions and will be permitted after a security search.

parking.note: Rosemont Theatre parking arrangements and rates vary by event. Review the theatre's official visitor information and event page before arrival.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Rosemont Theatre's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage service may be available inside Rosemont Theatre and varies by event. Outside food and beverages are prohibited unless required for a documented medical need.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Wheelchair area is located behind sections 113 and 116 (depending on event set-up behind sections 105 and 108 may also be available). Please note that the number of seats available in the accessible seating area meets the requirements of the Americans With Disabilities Act (ADA) and other laws relating to accessibility, however, the number of seats in the accessible seating areas is limited.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Rosemont Theatre's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Rosemont Theatre. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Rosemont Theatre. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
